summary: Astron Science Innovations is a modern science and space-education company dedicated to bridging the gap between complex astronomical research and everyday learning. We provide accessible stargazing hardware, interactive educational kits, and user-friendly sky-mapping software for schools, hobbyists, and aspiring researchers.
